case: a capital sigma folds to a medial sigma
a lowercase final sigma folds to a medial sigma
a dotted capital I is left alone
a long s folds to s, which lowercasing leaves alone
a capital sharp s folds to one sharp s, not to ss
a micro sign folds to a Greek mu
Cherokee small letters fold to their capitals
a letter outside the Basic Multilingual Plane folds
a decomposed accent composes around the fold
